newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's economic visionaries prove expensive.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's economic visionaries prove expensive.

text.p: Members of a committee set up by Nigeria's military government to work out an economic vision for the next century have been told to stop running up massive hotel bills, the national news agency said on Wednesday.

Organisers of the "Vision 2010" committee have sent a letter to its more than 120 members at their hotel in the capital Abuja, saying they should stick to non-alcoholic drinks and spend no more than 5,000 naira ($60) per day on food, the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) said.
"Sources close to the committee told NAN that some members were in the habit of entertaining their guests at the expense of the committee," the agency said.

The committee, which includes many top business chiefs, heads of ministries, government bodies and traditional rulers was set up to find a way out of Nigeria's economic morass -- which many Nigerians blame on years of government waste and over-spending.
